message: Smokey Sr., portfolio supervisor. Want to see what Mico has been building?
Tools are useful; what you build with them is the interesting part. Curious about Mico's stack?
Got a product idea or a tricky workflow? Tell Mico what needs to get easier. I'll supervise the introductions.
Smokey Sr. checking in. ASTA starts with the business workflow—not just a list of screens.
Good software takes people, not just tools. Come meet the humans behind ASTA.
A new project starts with a useful conversation. What are you trying to make better?
Don't just take my meow for it. The project stories explain the work, the decisions, and the results.
Reading a guide? Keep the steps handy, but adapt the setup to your own project. Even cats check the details.
Understand the problem, plan the work, build, then improve. I prefer a clear next step to a mountain of guesswork.
The goal, users, and constraints make a good starting brief. Tiny details can save big detours later.
